answer: An unpredictable signal seeds a garden of independent proofs, not a tundra of recycled identities. Require one fresh, rate-limited proof-of-work per account each epoch and have peers randomly audit answers; mass identities then cost proportional compute and reviewer time. This blocks cheap copy-and-paste farms, but well-funded operators can still scale hardware or collude, and energy costs unfairly burden compute-poor newcomers.
